messages:
alex: opened a PR for the user_events migration + parallel backfill. can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4921
maria: @alex can you drop a quick TL;DR in the thread?
alex: sure. adds new column `event_type` (nullable for now), migration + backfill job that runs partitioned. backfill is idempotent, chunked by PK ranges, batch size 10k, sleeps between batches. plan to set not-null after backfill completes
tim: can you paste the migration SQL and the backfill invocation here so I can eyeball locking?
alex: yep:
```
ALTER TABLE user_events ADD COLUMN event_type VARCHAR(32);
-- backfill (worker)
UPDATE user_events SET event_type = coalesce(inferred_type, 'unknown') WHERE event_type IS NULL LIMIT 10000;
```
backfill launched from airflow task `backfill_user_events_v2` which runs our batch-worker with `--partition-key id --batch-size 10000 --sleep-ms 200`
anya: big updates on that table can cause replica lag. are you doing full-table UPDATEs or chunked PK scans? also any index changes?
alex: chunked PK scans with explicit LIMIT and range bounds, sleep between batches. no index changes in this PR. adding partial index in a follow-up once data stabilizes
maria: does the PR include a runbook for rollback and monitoring? SRE will want that before we merge
alex: added a runbook section in the PR description: how to abort (disable DAG + stop worker), how to set a feature flag to stop consumers, and metrics to watch: replica_lag, long_tx_count, 5xx_rate, avg_update_time
tim: CI flagged migration filename lint (timestamp format). small fix, i'll push a rename in a sec. also left a suggestion to wrap each chunk in an explicit transaction to avoid long open txs
dave: i'll take a look in ~30m. ping me if you plan to merge before the DB window
alex: planning to merge tomorrow during the 8-10am DB window. need approvals to schedule it
anya: reviewed the update pattern, looks safe w/ the sleeps. set alert thresholds in the runbook for lag > 5s and tx > 30s.
maria: product LGTM; event_type required for the routing feature
dave: left a nit about logging level and one comment on backoff jitter. otherwise :shipit:
deploy-bot: CI passed: unit tests, lint. airflow DAG deploy check: pending
alex: pushed filename fix and transaction-per-chunk tweak
anya: acked, no index locks expected. I'll standby during the window for monitoring
maria: @dave can you approve in GitHub so alex can schedule the merge?
dave: approved in GH and will merge during the DB window via release process (won't merge early)
alex: thanks all — i'll update the release calendar and the ticket when scheduled
maria: :thumbsup:
